name: Protect the Frontier
summary: Guard Thomas watches Elwynn's eastern bridge as predators threaten the frontier. Stormwind's forces are thin here, and wolves and bears have grown bold near the Eastvale Logging Camp. He asks capable adventurers to cull the beasts threatening travelers and workers.

sections.title: A Thinning Defense
sections.body: Guard Thomas watches the bridge over the river at Elwynn Forest's eastern edge. Goldshire and the Northshire Valley have a visible Stormwind garrison, but this frontier receives far less protection. With Stormwind's forces stretched across the realm, Thomas is one of few sentries between the settled heartlands and the wilderness. Travelers help keep vital supply roads open.

sections.title: The Predatory Threat
sections.body: Eastvale Logging Camp supplies timber to Stormwind City, but woodsmen felling trees at the forest's edge meet dangerous wildlife. Prowlers, gray forest wolves, and young forest bears now roam near roads and lumber yards. Culling them eases the danger to local workers for a time. Thomas suspects a disturbance deeper in the woods is driving the beasts toward settlements.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Protect the Frontier?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas gives the order. He watches the eastern bridge on Elwynn Forest's main road, between the forest interior and the Eastvale region.

faq.q: Why are wolves and bears attacking the frontier?
faq.answer: Wolves and bears are pressing near roads and work sites around Eastvale Logging Camp. Thomas suspects something deeper in the wilderness is agitating them and driving them toward settled ground.

faq.q: Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp?
faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp lies in eastern Elwynn Forest, just east of Guard Thomas's bridge. It supplies vital lumber to Stormwind and border settlements.

faq.q: Why is Guard Thomas watching the bridge alone?
faq.answer: Stormwind's army and city guard are stretched thin across the kingdom. River and crossroads outposts often have only one or two guards watching the highways, so they rely on travelers to handle large wildlife threats.

faq.q: What animals need to be culled for this task?
aliases: what mobs for protect the frontier
faq.answer: You need to slay eight wolves, either prowlers or gray forest wolves, and five young forest bears roaming eastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What happens once the wildlife is culled?
faq.answer: When you report back, Guard Thomas thanks you, and logging caravans can travel more safely. He remains wary that the dark influence that stirred the beasts may bring further trouble to the forest.

angles.text: Keeping the eastern roads secure helps Eastvale's lumber reach Alliance lands, where it supports reconstruction and defense.
As a hunter, you can test your tracking and marksmanship against the wolves and bears stalking eastern Elwynn Forest.
